resources.string: Remote access will stop. The device record will remain. Reinstallation requires access to the computer.
The device record and its history will be deleted. The agent is not uninstalled and may register again.
Request sent. Checking the device list; execution is not confirmed.
The device is absent from the refreshed list. Deletion or a change in access may cause this.
The agent is disconnected. Uninstallation is not confirmed.
The result is unknown. Check the device before repeating the action.
Read from an online agent. Up to 1000 programs; unavailable values stay unknown.
No software list received. Check the agent and permissions; reconnect before retrying a timed-out request.
Runs as the agent account, usually SYSTEM or root. Commands may change the computer and be logged by the server. No cancellation or exit code is available. Do not enter secrets.
No result confirmed. The command may still be running. Check in the terminal before repeating it.
Up to 65536 characters. Output does not prove success; verify the intended change.
Reported power and connectivity history. Gaps are unknown, not downtime. The list below shows up to 100 recent transitions.
Up to 20 per profile. Select to edit the local draft, then insert without Enter. Single line only; do not save secrets.
